title: Cross-precision calibration & perf harness for long-horizon batching interactions
creator: Marco Rivera
description: Goal: Build a reproducible throughput and latency benchmarking harness that measures interactions between FP8/INT8 quantized model variants and real-world continuous-batch workloads across long-context scenarios (8k/32k/64k). The harness must capture steady-state throughput, warmup behavior (KV-cache priming), prefix-caching effects, and percentiles (p50/p90/p95/p99) for both single-request and multi-request batching. We will validate accuracy regressions using a held-out calibration+eval corpus (perplexity, SQuAD-style exact match where applicable, and embedding cosine drift). Deliverables: 1) benchmarking harness with config permutations, 2) calibration workflow blueprint (calibration passes, per-layer scale storage), 3) validation report template with regression thresholds and mitigation steps, 4) automated dashboards and release gating criteria for quantized model rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run end-to-end on dedicated dev-GPU pool and output p50/p95/p99 latency and tokens/sec for permutations of precision (fp32/fp16/fp8/int8), batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16,32], and context lengths [4k,8k,32k,64k]
Calibration artifacts (scale tables, per-layer histograms) are versioned and attached to artifact storage with model + commit metadata
Accuracy validation generates a pass/fail signal using thresholds: perplexity drift < 2%, embedding cosine similarity > 0.985, and task-specific EM/F1 within defined tolerance
Run results populate time-series dashboards and a per-run JSON summary that the rollout system can ingest for canary gating
comments: 2025-03-01 — Marco Rivera: Created ticket; initial scope agreed with applied-research and runtime teams. Priority set to P1 due to upcoming Dedicated pilot rollout.

2025-03-04 — Aisha Patel: Spike completed measuring KV-cache warmup on 8k context with FP8 candidate — observed ~12% higher p95 compared to fp16 for cold-start requests. Need to capture priming pattern in harness (prefix sequence length and request cadence).

2025-03-06 — Review (Applied ML): We should add per-layer activation histograms and outlier counters to calibration artifacts so we can debug per-layer clipping vs scale mismatch. Action: include histogram dump every calibration epoch.

2025-03-09 — Eng (Ravi Singh): Implemented initial harness runner and permutation engine. Runner supports concurrency 1..64, batch coalescing window 50ms, and synthetic workload generator reproducing PLG chat traffic patterns. PR opened: runtime#4321.
2025-03-11 — PM (Leah Chen): Requested that embedding drift be measured using both s-BERT embeddings and our internal similarity store for downstream search regressions. Added to acceptance criteria.

2025-03-13 — Aisha Patel: Found an intermittent regression in int8 variant at 32k context under high concurrency: tokens/sec drops ~18% after KV-cache eviction threshold. Hypothesis: quantized KV cache representation causes extra memory pressure leading to more frequent kernel swaps. Added dependency on ENG-71290 (KV cache eviction telemetry).

2025-03-14 — Aisha Patel: Next steps — finalize calibration pass configs (per-layer clipping vs symmetric/asymmetric quant), run full matrix overnight with 4 seeds, and produce validation report draft by 2025-03-18. Blocker: GPU availability for large-matrix runs; coordinating with infra team.
test_plan: Unit tests for harness config parsing and permutation expansion
Integration run: small matrix (fp16,fp8,int8) across batch sizes [1,8,32] on a 4-GPU dev cluster to validate telemetry and JSON summary format
Scale run: full matrix overnight on dedicated perf pool; compare against baseline fp16 runs and produce delta report
Regression test: automated canary gating that rejects model rollout if any accuracy metric breaches tolerance or p99 latency increases > 25% for P95-targeted routes
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Long-context runs are very GPU/time intensive and may queue behind other infra work — Mitigation: prioritize a compact fiducial subset (8k/32k) for fastest feedback and schedule full 64k runs during maintenance window
Risk: Calibration-induced accuracy regressions in downstream tasks — Mitigation: keep fallback path to higher-precision variant and automated rollback in rollout system
Risk: Measurement noise from autoscaling artifacts in Dedicated pool — Mitigation: pin test runs to reserved dev capacity and disable autoscaling for benchmark windows
final_notes: This ticket focuses on the interaction surface between batching policies, KV cache semantics, and quantization-induced micro-behavior in the runtime. The resulting artifacts should enable the Optimize team to recommend default quantization profiles and batching knobs for common PLG workloads, and provide release gating signals for Dedicated and Hosted rollout pipelines.
